VariantSwitcher first variant is active by default
VariantSwitcher clicking a variant selects it and collapses the picker
VariantSwitcher clicking outside collapses the picker
VariantSwitcher pressing Escape collapses the picker
VariantSwitcher is hidden when uiVisible is false
VariantSwitcher does not render with only one variant
VariantSwitcher position=left places switcher on the left
VariantSwitcher position=right (default) places switcher on the right
